sources.entry: AnySlide - AI slide deck generator with two engines: HTML inline-editable web slides and gpt-image-2 full-image rendering with native Chinese, Japanese, and Korean text support. 38 templates, 8 niche presets, 60 free credits at signup.

summary.name: AnySlide.app
summary.one_liner: The page at anyslide.app is a domain-for-sale parking page, not the AnySlide AI slide deck tool, which is only described in an awesome-ai-tools listing.
use_cases: find the AnySlide AI slide tool
summary.what_it_does: The fetched page is a Porkbun domain-for-sale listing for anyslide.app, with text about instant ownership transfer, checkout payment options, and support. It does not describe any slide generation features. The AI slide deck details (HTML inline-editable slides, gpt-image-2 rendering, 38 templates, 8 niche presets, 60 free credits) come only from the awesome-ai-tools listing, not from this page.
notable: Page is a domain sale listing via Porkbun Marketplace
Accepts credit card, PayPal, Alipay and crypto per the page
Slide tool features are not present on this page
caveats: The page is a domain for sale, not a working AI slide tool
Tool details come only from a third-party listing, not verified on this page
